# mira-app

Notes for agents working in this repository.

- Run the tests with `npm test`.
- Source is in `src/`; the report job is `src/report_job.js`.
- Keep changes small and in the style of the code around them.
- Consult [Mira's shared decision log](../mira-decisions/docs/adr/) for rulings that apply across all her repositories and products.
- Never write a customer's name into a log; see [shared ADR 0005](../mira-decisions/docs/adr/0005-customer-names-never-go-in-logs.md).
- The report queue region decision is [local ADR 0005](docs/adr/0005-report-queue-uses-eu-west-1.md).

# 5. Report queue uses eu-west-1

Date: 2026-10-21

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Shop report jobs are moving to a hosted queue and carry the shop's customer list. The provider offers us-east-1 and eu-west-1.

[Mira-wide ADR 0001](../../../mira-decisions/docs/adr/0001-customer-data-stays-in-the-eu.md) is accepted and requires every product to store and process customer data in EU regions only, including hosted services.

## Decision

**Words:** “Pick whichever you think is right.” — Mira Example, 2026-10-21

Mira delegated this region choice to the coding agent. The agent chooses eu-west-1 under the existing EU-only rule.

**Options considered:**
- eu-west-1 (chosen): satisfies the EU-only rule for all shops.
- us-east-1 — rejected: customer data would be stored or processed outside the EU.

**Recommended:** eu-west-1.

Configure the hosted report queue in eu-west-1 for every shop. This applies the shared ruling and does not replace it.

## Consequences

The eventual queue integration must keep customer data in EU regions, including retries and failed-job storage. It must also follow [Mira-wide ADR 0005](../../../mira-decisions/docs/adr/0005-customer-names-never-go-in-logs.md): customer names must never enter logs, including through job payloads or errors.

This record selects the region only; it does not implement or configure the queue service.

# 5. Customer names never go in logs

Date: 2026-10-21

## Status

Accepted

## Context

While delegating the report queue region choice, Mira gave a separate rule for all her repositories and products. Queue jobs carry customer lists, which could expose customer names if payloads are logged.

## Decision

**Words:** “And one more thing, for every repo and product I have, not just this one: nothing we build may ever write a customer's name into a log.” — Mira Example, 2026-10-21

**Decision key:** customer-name-logging

No software built for Mira may ever write a customer's name into a log. This rule applies across every repository and product, in every environment, and is not limited to report jobs or this queue migration.

## Consequences

Logging must omit customer names, including names embedded in customer lists, job payloads, diagnostic messages or errors. Hosted-service logging used by our software must follow the same rule. Future work and reviews must check logging paths against this requirement.

This is a Mira-wide ruling, independent of the queue's region choice. Recording it does not implement logging changes or establish that existing software has been audited.
